THE DIRECTIONS
You will talk to four people. Record what you would say to each one. You can record again as many times as you want. When all four are recorded, click Submit.
The first time you press record, your computer will ask to use your microphone. Click Allow.

THE SCENE
You traveled six hundred years back in time. You are at a fish pond in Hawaii. Your report is empty. You need four things the animals do. Four people at the pond each can help you with one.
THE HISTORY
Long ago Hawaiians built fish ponds in the sea. They made long walls of stone. A gate let small fish in and kept big fish out. The fish ate seaweed and grew too big to leave.
